summary: Both new tests in commit 2bc3ba8 are load-bearing and close the round-1 gap. Test 1 ('debounce-persists an in-place trigger field edit exactly once after 600ms') directly mutates a field on the live triggers array that the page's deep watch observes, performs two rapid keystrokes inside the 600ms window, asserts silence before the window closes, then asserts exactly one storeMock.update call with the coalesced final value ('order_shipped') in sanitized array form. Removing the debounce (setTimeout 600) or the coalescing logic would break the toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1) assertion; removing the field-mutation path would yield no call at all. Test 2 ('does NOT debounce-persist while a trigger is incomplete') clears triggerValue to empty on a previously complete trigger, waits past 700ms, and asserts storeMock.update was never called. Removing the triggerReady gate (line 293: if (!triggers.value.every(triggerReady)) return) would cause a PATCH to fire and break the not.toHaveBeenCalled() assertion. Both tests use the same drain-and-clear pattern as the existing suite (700ms real-timer wait) which is consistent with how the file avoids fake-timer/microtask ordering issues. No editable-panel assertions were reintroduced. No hollow or tautological assertions found. The round-1 minor finding is closed.
